contradictions.what: Rep says they were building a portal, then says Paul's team isn't building anything and the portal is off the shelf with a plugin.
Rep says she learned about the CFO around the third call, yet says she lost a month; the timeline is vague and implies the CFO was found late.
Rep says the questions changed 'not much', then reports a new question about a named contact.
A reference was something they couldn't deliver and the customer raised it twice, yet she signed; this undercuts the idea it was needed.
Rep had the deal at 20 percent and 'dead' before the meeting, then says it was paperwork after, so there was a rapid swing from dead to won.
The hours and dollar figure are given from memory with hedges, so they are approximate.
